description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'EnableTestLanguagePackCommand' within the OrangeHRM project. The class facilitates enabling a test language pack, providing functionalities to create or delete the test language pack, and includes logic for handling different modes (production or non-production). It leverages traits and external classes such as 'EntityManagerTrait', 'LanguageHelper', and Symfony's console components to perform its tasks.

classes.name: EnableTestLanguagePackCommand
classes.description: A console command for enabling or deleting a test language pack in OrangeHRM, with logic to prevent execution in production mode and handle duplication conflicts.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for the command, used to invoke it from CLI.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to create a test language pack unless in production mode, and handles case where the pack already exists by optionally deleting it.
